mapper.insert: INSERT INTO async_task (task_id, task_type, task_name, status, progress, current_step, task_config, context_data, step_logs, error_message, max_retries, retry_count, created_time, updated_time, start_time, end_time, priority, timeout_seconds, version, creator) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{taskType}, #{taskName}, #{status}, #{progress}, #{currentStep}, #{taskConfig}, #{contextData}, #{stepLogs}, #{errorMessage}, #{maxRetries}, #{retryCount}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{priority}, #{timeoutSeconds}, #{version}, #{creator})
mapper.update: UPDATE async_task SET status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, current_step = #{currentStep}, context_data = #{contextData}, step_logs = #{stepLogs}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE async_task SET status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, current_step = #{currentStep}, task_config = #{taskConfig}, context_data = #{contextData}, step_logs = #{stepLogs}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, updated_time = #{updatedTime}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM async_task WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY priority DESC, created_time ASC
SELECT * FROM async_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND retry_count < max_retries) ORDER BY priority DESC, created_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM async_task WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND updated_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) ORDER BY priority DESC, updated_time ASC
